title: Mirrorball
description: A mirrorball in a dark club at 2am, every tile holding a fragment of the room. Throw it into a spin and real specks of light sweep the walls and this page's own words, stretching into ellipses as they graze.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge: each facet is a real mirror, so the specks are computed reflections of one spotlight, not decoration.
